host.label: HyperHDR address
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the machine HyperHDR runs on.

udp_port.label: UDP raw receiver port
udp_port.description: Port of HyperHDR's UDP raw receiver. Switch the receiver on in HyperHDR under Network Services, for the LED instance you want to drive.

web_port.label: Web port
web_port.description: Port of HyperHDR's web interface, used once to read how the LEDs are arranged.

token.label: API token
token.description: Only needed when HyperHDR runs on another machine and asks for authorization. Create one in HyperHDR under Advanced, Network Services, Token Management. Leave empty to keep the stored token.

effect.label: Effect
effect.description: How the music is drawn on the LEDs.

options.spectrum: Spectrum: bass at the bottom, treble at the top
options.vu: Level meter: one meter climbing both sides with the loudness, with a falling peak
options.pulse: Pulse: every LED flashes on the beat and goes dark in between
options.ripple: Ripple: a wave on every beat
options.energy: Energy: bass rises from the bottom, treble drops from the top; they meet in between
options.ambient: Ambient: calm colours turning around the screen; the music sets the speed, not the brightness
options.lumina: Lumina: one calm colour that gets brighter as the music gets louder
options.colora: Colora: steady brightness; the colour follows the sound, bass to treble
options.retro: Retro: graphic equaliser: eight frequency blocks with peak dots, like an old hi-fi
options.scanner: Scanner: a light sweeping back and forth, faster when louder
options.rhythm: Rhythm: colour blocks that swap on every beat
options.party: Party: random colour bursts on beats
options.flow: Flow: comets of light circling the screen, faster when louder
options.centre_pulse: Centre pulse: every beat sends a pulse from the middle of each edge to the corners
options.fireflies: Fireflies: small lights drifting around the screen; beats speed them up
options.snowfall: Snowfall: glowing flakes falling down the sides, more with the treble
options.crystals: Crystals: shards that flare with their own frequency and flutter with the treble
options.braids: Braids: two strands of colour winding along the sides, crossing as they move
options.embers: Embers: a flickering glow with sparks rising from the bottom on the bass
options.aurora: Aurora: slow, folded curtains of colour rising from the bottom
options.horizon: Horizon: a sun at the top pulsing with the bass, grid lines rushing down the sides
options.side_bars: Side bars: bars growing from the middle of each side: bass left, treble right
options.liquid: Liquid: swirling trails that zoom, twist and fade into themselves, like MilkDrop
options.manual: Manual: every LED in the custom colour, not following the music

palette.label: Colours
palette.description: Colours used by the effect. Album artwork follows the cover of the current track (shades of white for black-and-white covers, rainbow without a cover).

brightness.label: Brightness (%)
brightness.description: Brightness of the effect, on top of the brightness set in HyperHDR.

sensitivity_db.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity_db.description: How strongly the lights react. The level adapts to each track by itself; increase this if the effects look dim or flat, decrease it if they are stuck at maximum.

response.label: Light response
response.description: How quickly the lights follow the music.

latency_ms.label: Light timing (ms)
latency_ms.description: Makes the lights react slightly earlier so they stay in step with your speaker. Increase if the lights lag the music.

album_mode.label: Artwork colours
album_mode.description: How the Album artwork colours are picked from the cover.

options.natural: Natural: as they look on the cover
options.contrast: Contrast: the main colour and its opposite

color.label: Custom colour
color.description: Colour as #rrggbb, used by the Manual effect and the custom colours palette. Default warm white #ff9329.

user.title: Connect to HyperHDR
user.description: Enter the address of the machine HyperHDR runs on. In HyperHDR, switch on the UDP raw receiver under Network Services first.

manifest.name: HyperHDR Sync
manifest.description: Make the ambient LEDs driven by HyperHDR react to the music played by Music Assistant.

errors.cannot_connect: Could not reach HyperHDR. Check the address and web port, and that HyperHDR is running.
errors.auth_required: HyperHDR asks for authorization. Enter an API token created in HyperHDR under Token Management.
errors.no_leds: HyperHDR reports no LEDs. Set up the LED layout in HyperHDR first.
errors.too_many_leds: This HyperHDR instance has more than 500 LEDs, which its UDP raw receiver cannot take.
errors.already_configured: This HyperHDR instance is already set up.
